REMNANT · WARD C · BLENDER ENVIRONMENT · 11 OCTOBER 2026

No one is on call.

An abandoned hospital wing. Six wards open onto connected hallways, a treatment room and a nursing station. Broken glass, rusted medical equipment, damp plaster and dried blood mark what remains.

Walk the wing

Two intersecting 3.2 m hallways, seven ward/treatment doorways, a rear staff entrance and level floors keep the layout connected. Forty-eight window cells have physically open missing or broken centres. Original textured clinical surfaces carry damp, dust, dried pools, wall smears and faded shoe prints.

Independent architecture · Hospital shell GLB

What the staff left behind

Eight separate medical furniture sources, each with its own packed textures, GLB and three actual angles. The assembly uses 50 relative collection instances and reuses the existing independent telephone, mail and bin.

Blender 4.5.1 LTS · Cycles / OptiX · Environment: 128 samples at 1800 × 1200. Props: 80 samples at 1000 × 1000. Original PBR image maps, packed native images and embedded Y-up engine exports. All final images were visually opened and reviewed.

Reusable art assets. Gameplay placement, collision and engine lighting require scene setup. Cameras, exterior paving and presentation lighting stay outside exports. The overview removes ceilings and two perimeter walls temporarily; the saved model remains complete.
